title: Warmly-Kissed Croatian Hummus Burek
description: A sweet and chewy twist on traditional Croatian burek, featuring hummus, beurre monte, and tamasic-friendly spices.
instructions: Thaw phyllo dough according to package instructions.
In a medium bowl, mix together hummus, beurre monte, cinnamon, cardamom, ginger, and sugar.
Unroll phyllo dough and cut into 4 equal pieces.
Place a piece of phyllo dough on a flat surface and spread a quarter of the hummus mixture onto it.
Fold the phyllo dough over the filling to form a triangle.
Brush the edges with a little water and fold again to seal.
Brush the tops with unsalted butter and bake for 20 minutes.
Repeat with the remaining dough and filling.
Serve warm, dust with powdered sugar if desired.
